red_harvest.subject: A blood-red harvest moon hanging over a dark field where a single sword stands planted in the earth like a scarecrow, crimson light pooling around it.

bane_of_barbarians.subject: A horned barbarian skull helmet lying cracked on a stone, a shaft of golden light striking it from a parting sky, embers floating.

ashes_of_the_horde.subject: A single tall pillar of fire and smoke rising from a burning war camp far below, the smoke curling into the shape of a fleeing horse in the night sky.

fallen_crown.subject: A golden crown tumbling through the dark air, trailing sparks and falling gems, a faint silhouette of a city gate below.

hold_the_line.subject: A single battered round shield glowing with a protective blue aura, arrows frozen in the air around it, a dark storm behind.

scorched_earth.subject: A lone torch floating above blackened fields, burning embers drifting like fireflies over charred crop rows under a smoky red sky.

veterans_of_the_line.subject: Two crossed old swords hung with golden medals and laurel ribbons, floating in a soft beam of light on a dark ground.

steel_for_old_swords.subject: An old notched bronze sword transforming into gleaming steel along its length in a flare of blue-white sparks, floating over an anvil.

iron_tide.subject: A great wave made of countless spear tips and helmets cresting in the dark like a sea, an iron standard rising from its crest.

blood_and_thunder.subject: A war horn wreathed in crimson lightning floating in a thunderstorm, blood-red clouds swirling around it.

doom_of_kings.subject: A black crown on a toppled throne beneath a violet comet, the comet's tail splitting the sky above, dust and embers drifting.

doves_return.subject: A white dove carrying an olive sprig flying out of dark storm clouds into a single ray of soft dawn light.

seeds_of_empire.subject: Two glowing seeds sprouting in cupped earth, each sprout forming a tiny luminous city of towers, green light rising.

teeming_masses.subject: A great glowing wheat sheaf whose grains shine like hundreds of tiny lanterns, each a family, floating in a warm dusk sky.

shining_city.subject: A radiant capital city on a hill glowing like a lantern in the night, its towers shining gold, light beams rising to the stars.

hands_to_the_soil.subject: Two earthy hands pressing seeds into dark soil that glows with green and golden light, a plough and a hoe resting beside them.

widening_realm.subject: Glowing golden border lines spreading outward like ripples across a dark painted landscape seen from above, a small banner at the centre.

coin_of_the_realm.subject: A single enormous gold coin spinning in the air trailing golden light, its face showing only a sun emblem, smaller coins orbiting it.

stone_upon_stone.subject: Carved stone blocks floating and stacking themselves into the first course of a tower, glowing mortar lines, a mason's trowel hovering.

wonder_for_the_ages.subject: A distant golden pyramid glowing on the horizon at night with a beam of light shooting from its tip to a constellation above.

heavenly_accord.subject: Two golden sun discs slowly aligning in a luminous sky above two monuments, rays of light joining between them.

font_of_knowledge.subject: A glowing crystal fountain in the dark pouring streams of blue light that turn into floating open books and orbiting stars.

beyond_the_edge.subject: A brass compass floating over the dark edge of the world where the ocean pours off into a starry abyss, its needle glowing.

relics_of_the_ancients.subject: An ornate ancient bronze key and a cracked stone idol half-buried in sand, lit by a single ray of light from above in a dark ruin.

word_of_law.subject: A rolled decree bound with a ribbon and a heavy wax seal floating in the air, a beam of magenta light radiating from the seal, no writing visible.

days_of_revelry.subject: A jewelled festival mask floating above a night of fireworks, confetti and lantern light swirling around it in magenta and gold.
